title: When Respondents Are Scarce: LLM-Derived Semantic Priors for Bayesian Confirmatory Factor Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.34843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Across social and behavioral research, measuring latent constructs can be challenging when target populations are small or difficult to reach. Recruiting additional respondents may be costly or infeasible, leaving researchers with limited data for estimating questionnaire factor structures. Yet item wording contains structural expectations before data collection, and whether these can improve small-sample estimation without replacing empirical validation remains unclear. We introduce the Semantic-Empirical Updating Framework (SEUF), which converts large language model paraphrases and embeddings, aligned with hypothesized item-factor assignments, into prespecified priors for Bayesian confirmatory factor analysis. We evaluated SEUF using a 38-item survey of 617 industrial-park stakeholders and two public surveys, FEVS and RIASEC. Semantic structure persisted after wording controls across all three instruments. translated_abstract: 在整个社会与行为科学研究中，当目标人群规模较小或难以触达时，测量潜在构念可能面临挑战。招募更多受访者可能成本高昂或不可行，导致研究者可用于估计问卷因子结构的数据十分有限。然而，条目措辞在数据收集之前就已包含结构性预期，但这些预期是否能够在不取代实证验证的前提下改进小样本估计，仍不清楚。我们提出了语义-实证更新框架（SEUF），该框架将大语言模型生成的释义和嵌入向量，与假设的条目-因子归属关系对齐后，转化为贝叶斯验证性因子分析的预设先验。我们使用一项针对617名工业园区利益相关者的38题问卷以及两项公开调查数据（FEVS和RIASEC）对SEUF进行了评估。结果显示，在所有三个测量工具中，即使控制了措辞因素，语义结构依然存在。当受访者仅有50人时，SEUF达到了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出语义-实证更新框架（SEUF），将大语言模型生成的释义和嵌入向量转化为贝叶斯验证性因子分析的预设先验，从而在受访者稀缺、样本量有限的情况下提升问卷潜在构念因子结构的估计效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Semantic-Empirical Updating Framework (SEUF), which converts LLM-derived paraphrases and embeddings into prespecified priors for Bayesian confirmatory factor analysis, improving estimation of questionnaire factor structures when respondents are scarce and sample sizes are small.
